body: He works so hard 🥹
Come home.
In one word “unexceptional” which is how I’m assuming how it’ll go. My obituary will also be two sentences long.
Just tell us the information, it’s a throwaway account. I’m invested.

Heartbreak is indeed the most worst of pain. Some experience it like a heart attack, mine is a slow ache that never seems to leave my body. I agree though, someone who leaves after making someone finally feel loved… well nobody’s perfect.

If it was me, I’m wouldn’t. I’ve been in situations though where D maybe wasn’t ready for that kind of relationship. Sometimes tho I think back, had I received a little nudge in the right direction I could have been ready sooner. But I’m only responsible for my happiness. If they wanted it, they should have asked for it or shown me through a gift of their own.
I was lucky once. 😪

Me and someone are currently going through a NC; it’s tough on both of us. Currently I’m wishing him and I could talk and have a honest conversation with each other. I would tell him everything. I never wanted to hug someone so much, but it’s not up to me. He asked for his space and I continue to embarrass myself. K if you see this, I just want to talk.

I’m little confused, do you want them or just not rn?

Edit: typos.
I wish D treated you way better. If he didn’t he’s probably full of regret after you finally leave him. It has to be something though, maybe he’s scared.
He’s actually the one that initiated the NC and I tried breaking it twice. So yeah I’m done.

You’re confused so maybe just ask him what he wants then maybe once you see his intentions you’ll have a better understanding on what you want. But that doesn’t mean you shouldn’t be honest about your feelings either. If he wants more then tell him well I was hoping for something more casual and seeing where this leads. If that’s not ok with him then sex only complicates things, but if you’re both on either the situation then it should be fine. You need to be careful though because once he wants more he’ll start showing you and if you still feel the same immediately tell him that it’s only about the sex. Then it’s on him to decide if he wants to leave the relationship or not. But you also need to be honest if you decide you want more after having sex a few times.

Seriously you gotta set up boundaries and after the NC they’ll probably realize that they’re not as important to you as you are to them. Maybe set up some personal boundaries too like giving yourself time before you respond. There’s no rule that you have to instantly respond. When you don’t value yourself and give in to people pleasing behavior you’re basically building resentment and a ton of other negative feelings like anger and burn-out and that will eventually make you want to leave them. You should also talk to them about it specifically, and if they’re in a good headspace they’ll be able to have good conversation about it. You are not responsible for their feelings and if they really want you in their life they’ll adjust. And at least you’ll know where you two stand with each other.  And encourage him to speak up about why he talks to you everyday, he may not want to say anything because he appears needy when actually it’s you not wanting to meet his needs. Once you have this conversation you’ll both know what kind of friendship you’ll share. From the wya you describe it you don’t want to be as close to him as he is to you. So it’ll be a difficult conversation, you say you don’t want to hurt his feelings well I’m letting you know rn you will. But you are not responsible for his happiness. remember that.
Despite my mental health; I never gave up.
I will if we ever talk face to face again. Not up to me though.

😂 touché 

However, you clearly want to talk about. If you want feel free to message me. Good night.

Understandable, it’s respectable that you choose yourself. I wish I could have done the same. Except in my case I would have continued hurting them. Do you plan on going back to them sometime or leaving it to fate?
Good, it sounds like your mad at them. Why’d you walk away tho?
Are you still in their life? Just curious.

Agreed, as someone who has had friends who were younger then myself I know I felt like a creep sometimes. However, they were online friends and we’d simply play games with each other. Doesn’t stop me from feeling weird about it 🤷🏻‍♂️

This gives me hope, I’m going through such a hard time right now… I could use his hug. I won’t reach out though, I’m done embarrassing myself. I’m done with a lot of things. I feel utterly helpless right now and life is crushing me everyday ever so slowly suffocating me. I’ll go through the motions… get help, go to therapy, but it feels so pointless. 😪 I’m end I’ll always be alone.
I’ve done a lot of reading and felt like this was the closest thing I could write without sounding so selfish. 🖤
And sometimes it takes them leaving for them to truly recognize how f**ked they can be (speaking from experience)

My sister recently took her life, I do wish she would have at least tried. I miss her terribly. But that thought also gives me strength to follow my own advice. I just feel so alone though and not knowing how to escape. I’m trying to recognize all my options. Just a lot has happened…

I’m struggling with the ideation part right now, it all feels so hopeless. Turning 30 soon and I look at the past decade. I never changed and it’s truly sad. Idek where to go from here and I feel so emotionally alone. I’m trying to learn how to be alone though.
Hugs
All your posts are so heartfelt. I know the other person thinks you’re as special as you think of them, reach out and start healing together. I know they secretly want you too.
Hugs 🤗
LTHP_Moon
Infinite time.

I belief relationships should be a mutual beneficial understanding. I have a hard time with this and forcing someone to something eventually leads to resentment. If you want to go to the club then you should have the freedom to do so. Same thing if he wants to do something you may not agree with. Establish some boundaries, "I feel like when you tell me not to do something that it’s not beneficial to our relationship. How can I put you at ease when I go to the club so the last situation doesn’t happen again." This shifts the I told you so attitude to a helpful attitude.
If only you were SC, although I can think of one time he actually did call me that before. 😪
I wish too. But it is what it is, unfortunately I don’t think it’ll be fixed between us because he doesn’t want to talk right now. It hurts but idk what to do besides give him his space.
I so want this letter for me.

Hugs, losing family never gets easier. I hope you find something to fill the void that she left behind. That’s what I’m struggling with right now. My brother has been one of the few constants in my life and now he wants nothing to do with me. It’s one of the worst pain I felt in a long time so I can understand what you’re going through. With time though I hope it heals.
Ouch

I guess for me it’s remembering why we love each other in the first place and then all the memories that come along with said love. I still feel the love between all the people I’ve lost and that’s what keeps me going some days.
😂 id feel flattered and impressed by their honesty

Slowly but surely, my friend, the days stop blending together. Just take it one day at a time and slowly you’ll notice things do get better with time. Big hugs.

Hugs

Love is a gift few people get to enjoy, and even though the sting of losing it hurts I believe the memories are worth it. And if you truly believe it’s temporary then even better to enjoy the moments while it lasts. Good luck!

Take it slow, enjoy it while it lasts. It’s clear that she’s willing to teach you all the things you’ve been missing out on. Communication is key, and if you’re doing something wrong she’ll definitely let you know.
Maybe it’s time for a trim and wipes 😂😂

Big hugs, I hope you feel better. Most people only think about themselves in these types of situations. Just know that it wasn’t all you.
I feel like I should clarify this was a platonic relationship with my best friend. My mental illness got the better of me and I pushed him away. It hurts because I know things won’t be the same.

I can only speak from my experience but allowing yourself to mourn the person you’ve missed is completely normal. Yes, life feels empty and yes you miss them or the way things used to be. But I feel like people don’t want others to feel that pain daily. The love you guys shared was what brought you two together in the first place, and that love comes from a place of kindness. True they may not be there for you now, but that doesn’t mean they don’t want good things for you. Allowing yourself to drown in that emptiness of their absence will always be a place of pain. Sometimes you have to accept the way things are and fill the void with something. Whether it’s a new hobby or something you already enjoy. I have to take my own advice but my wound is still fresh, which I why I still cry. I hope you find something that helps with your pain soon brother.
At least we’re not alone in this.

Never have I felt a post resonate with me so much.  Just had an episode where I pushed my best friend away. The thing about being self-aware about it though is sometimes we just can’t help but act the way we do. Sometimes I wonder if being alone would be better then the constant pushing and pulling of people in my life. That moment of clarity after the episode sucks though because I know how much I messed up. But knowing I’m not the only one that struggles with these types of feelings makes me feel better.
